description: Genuine Mario gameplay: walk to the first question block, jump and collect its coin; jump again and stomp the Goomba; walk to the next lower question block, hit it to release a mushroom, and land. Continue briefly as the mushroom finishes emerging and starts moving right along the blocks. Uniformly sampled ordered stills for scroll-driven display only.

capture.game: Classic NES Series - Super Mario Bros.
capture.runtime: qemu-arm-static 7.2.22, ARM1176 CPU; stock SeedSigner runtime libraries
capture.container_isolation: Network disabled; read-only container root filesystem; inputs (ROM, frontend, core, runtime, script) mounted read-only; capture-only volume writable. Temporary containers and volumes removed after screenshots were copied back.
capture.encoding: Pillow 12.3.0; lossless PNG from original 240x160 RGB PPM; decoded pixels compared byte-for-byte; no scaling, interpolation, retouching or compositing of the frame assets
capture.determinism: All 135 selected raw PPM frames were byte-for-byte identical to an independent replay of the exact same input script with the same production frontend, core and runtime. In addition, the original selected frames 352 through 840 were byte-for-byte identical to the previous final capture; all original 123 embedded PNG records and data_uri strings were preserved exactly.
capture.provenance: Screenshots captured locally from the user-provided cartridge dump with the unchanged current production frontend and exact separate classic core. The exact existing input script was replayed for 48 additional emulated frames, extending the selected endpoint from 840 to 888 without adding controller inputs. No game ROM or proprietary BIOS files are included.

events.event_frame_precision: Events are visually checked against genuine captures at a four-frame cadence; first-observed frame labels may follow the exact event by up to three emulated frames.
events.tail_observation: The mushroom finishes emerging above the used second question block and begins moving right on the blocks. Mario remains landed below; the HUD still shows score 300 and coin 01 at frame 888.
events.original_action_endpoint_preserved: The original final_landed_mushroom_score_300_coin_01_frame and final_file retain the original action endpoint at source frame 840 / mario-123.png; tail_end_frame and tail_end_file identify the extended sequence endpoint.

rights: Super Mario Bros. and game artwork: Nintendo. These are gameplay screenshot excerpts; game copyright remains with Nintendo and its rights holders. The user-provided game ROM is not included or distributed.
delivery_description: Lossless PNG bytes embedded in each frame data_uri; file names are logical capture identifiers.
